title: Baby Leo & Friends Learn About Kind Words!
summary: Today, Baby Leo and his friends learn about the power of kind words! Bella has a fun game to show how saying nice things can make everyone feel happy. Together, they discover that kind words are magic that brings smiles to their faces!
lesson: Kids learn the importance of using kind words.
beats: Baby Leo and friends gather at the colorful play area, remembering how much fun they had learning about kindness in a previous episode.
Bella hops in excitedly and shares her idea about a game that shows how kind words can make everyone feel good.
Marjona says she loves to sing kind words, and Bobo suggests they create kind word notes for each other.
The friends begin writing kind words on colorful paper, giggling and sharing sweet compliments.
Suddenly, Marjona realizes she has forgotten how to write a kind note, feeling sad.
Bobo gives Marjona a warm hug and tells her it's okay. They all gather around to help her.
With Baby Leo's help, Marjona writes a kind note that says, 'You are a wonderful friend!'
The friends take turns reading their notes aloud, giggling and smiling as they hear all the nice words.
They learn that kind words can brighten someone's day and make them feel loved.
In the end, they make a big colorful poster with all the kind words and hang it in their play area, feeling happy and proud!
